assertions.criteria: Must explicitly use `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` in PostgreSQL to prevent full table read/write locks.
Must specify that the concurrent index creation cannot be executed inside a multi-statement transaction block.
Must recommend using `EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS)` to diagnose query resource consumption and Seq Scans.
Must demonstrate a covering index using `INCLUDE` or composite syntax to satisfy index-only scans and avoid heap fetch buffers.
